title: Four computed findings from the official depth, roster and game-book captures

rows.claim: Every Detroit player the report marked Out is also on the Game Book's Not Active list
rows.evidence: 2 of 3 matched: Cade Mays, D.J. Reed

rows.claim: The club's rank-1 depth slots and the Game Book's first-string lineup identify the same players
rows.evidence: 1 of 21 depth rank-1 surnames appear in the Game Book lineup; 21 Game Book starters are not rank 1 on the chart: ahutchinson, amcneill, bbranch, bmiller, cclark, cmahogany, dbarnes, iteslaa, jgibbs, jgoff, jscruggs, jwilliams, mrodriguez, psewell, rmccreary, rya-sin, slaporta, tlacy, tnowaske, tratledge, twilliams

rows.claim: A rank-1 depth player can be Out while the Game Book still lists him first-string
rows.evidence: D.J. Reed was rank 1 CB on the club chart and Out on the report; the Game Book lists him in the starting lineup at CB (R.Ya-Sin, R.McCreary). The inactives list also carries him.

rows.claim: The club depth chart names at least one player who is not on the active roster
rows.evidence: Rank-1 safety Kerby Joseph is on the club chart and is published by nfl.com with roster status PUP. Players on the chart whose status is not ACT: none
